original.title: Full-history nonpast roots biject with pending diagonal holes
original.statement: For a currently fresh old column with full strict postbirth history H and corresponding diagonal set G, its actual private source map is an injective strictly increasing map from H onto G. Nonpast history labels are H minus G, so their count equals |G minus H|. The resulting paths biject original nonpast roots with distinct pending diagonal holes.
assumptions: Full canonical journal, continuing liveness, exact MEX absence, low-cell/row-start hook and D/S disjointness.

exactAuditedStatement: For currently fresh old column c at rowq, H={f(a, c):c<a<q}, G={d(a):c<a<q}, the actual source map Phi:H->G is bijective and satisfies Phi(h)>h for every h. Nonpast(H)=H minus G; |nonpast(H)|=|G minus H|. Directed Phi paths biject original nonpast roots H minus G with pending diagonal holes G minus H.
hypotheses: Currentfreshness>old record T; full strict postbirth history; seed exclusion and current MEX coverage.
Inflationary inequality Phi(h)>h is intended; no order-preserving property h<h prime=>Phi(h)<Phi(h prime)is asserted.
proofDependencyMap: Shared canonical foundation: exact positive-MEX/COPY recurrence and P01-P12, independently reconstructed in ../CANONICAL-FOUNDATIONS.md with exact declaration mapping and game interpretation. DEPENDENCIES.json records the additional service lemmas. Final kernel receipts bind the source versions.
Full journal nonreuse; row max; diagonal/frozen label disjointness.
independentDerivationAndChecks: Current fresh cell cannot be copied, so column has not frozen earlier. All private awards are distinct and outside seeds D_<=c; each original row a has one award. Thus source row map H->(c, q) is bijective, and distinct diagonals yield Phi image G. Since c<a, strict row max gives Phi(h)=d(a)>h.
Every past diagonal owner is<=c or in(c, q); the seed part is excluded from H, so exactly H intersect G are past labels. Equal cardinalities give|H minus G|=|G minus H|.

For z in G minus H, diagonal injectivity also excludes the seed set, so z is absent from full journal. Since z<=T<current fresh MEX, it must occur before c in rowq. A currently present diagonal label cannot be<=q: values<q are frozen blockers and value q would be a blocker by P07. Thus q<z<=T; distinct exits have unique distinct holders.

The finite graph h->Phi(h) has indegree/outdegree<=1 and strictly increases along edges, so acyclic. Roots H minus G and exits G minus H pair exactly along paths. This needs inflationarity only. Max G is outsideH because each h<Phi(h)<=max G, giving a nonempty exit when H nonempty.

If visible first-fresh surplus P is defined as actual H-labels held before c, it is disjoint from exits and prefix capacity gives|nonpast H|+|P|<=c. This is conditional on the precise surplus definition and does not assert arbitrary surplus labels are roots.
defects: Catalogue phrase "injective strictly increasing map" can state the stronger, unproved order-preserving property. Source argument proves only Phi(h)>h.
exactCorrection: Replace by "an injective source map with image exactly G and Phi(h)>h for every h". No canonical counterexample to order-preservation is claimed; it is not needed and was not proved.
